lines: No goodbyes, no promises
Because we'll meet again
The horizon takes a small bite of an orange
The bittersweet light is so bright
Sweat sliding down, voices ringing out
Shoulders knocking, laughing together, crying
Toward tomorrow, into the orange sky
We'll spread our wings and fly
Just one more second, just one more second
This moment we can't help wishing to hold onto
Surely
Carrying a big dream on a small back
We've come all this way
It wasn't only the future we pictured
But it was fun, all of it, wasn't it
Out of breath, we just kept running
What we were chasing was the heat in our chests, right
Moments that will never come again
May they stay connected forever
What should I draw? What should I do?
I try to imagine, but
Surely
Surely
Even the certain things, someday we'll understand
It's okay to be wrong, so don't be afraid
You can just be you, oh
Like an orange, a little bitter
The ache it leaves behind
Just one more second, just one more second
We'll go on, cherishing it as we leave
This limited time, someday
Even if it suddenly makes us long for it
Don't stop, don't look back
You just have to keep moving forward
Surely
Surely
